blocks.text: Terms of Use ke andar user ke personal rights (apne zaati haq) mein teen haq shamil hain: privacy ka haq, maloomat milne (informed hone) ka haq, aur apni consent (ijazat ya razamandi) wapas lene ka haq. User ke liye zaroori hai ke woh apne yeh rights jaane aur samjhe ke inhein kaise istemal kare.

Misal: Kitab ke mutabiq Pakistan ke Personal Data Protection Bill ke mutabiq user ko haq hai ke woh apna data dekhe aur us mein correction (ghalti theek karna) ya deletion (mitana) ki request (darkhwast) kare. Local e-commerce websites jaisi services istemal karte waqt user ko haq hai ke use pata ho ke us ki personal maloomat, jaise ghar ka pata aur phone number, kaise istemal hogi. Agar user platform chhorna chahe to use haq hai ke apna account aur data delete kare, ta ke us ki maloomat na rakhi jaye na istemal ho.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Bill qanoon ka draft (kaccha khaaka) hota hai; jab tak parliament use pass na kare woh qanoon nahi banta. Is liye check kar lein ke abhi yeh bill qanoon bana hai ya nahi.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Kuch online platforms apni Terms of Use aksar badalte rehte hain. Achha hai ke inhein thore thore waqt baad parhte rahein ta ke har tabdeeli ka pata rahe.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Students ko groups mein baant kar har group ko alag Terms of Use document diya jaye. Har group zaroori clauses ko highlight kare, jaise User Obligations, Privacy and Data Use, Limitations of Liability aur Termination of Service. Phir ek worksheet di jaye jis mein sawal hon: user ki bari zimmedariyan kya hain, user ka data kaise sambhala jata hai, liability ki kya hadein likhi hain, aur service kin halaat mein khatam ho sakti hai. Aakhir mein students kisi aam istemal hone wali website ya app ki Terms of Use ke zaroori points aur clauses ka summary (khulasa) banayein.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: Terms of Use ka khulasa banate waqt kin baaton ka hona zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: User ko kya karna hai aur kya mana hai (User Obligations); kaunsa data jama hota hai aur kaise istemal aur mehfooz hota hai (Privacy and Data Use); provider kin cheezon ki zimmedari nahi leta (Limitations of Liability); account kab aur kaise band ho sakta hai (Termination of Service); aur user apne rights, jaise data delete karwana, kaise istemal kare.

items: Personal rights: privacy, maloomat milna, consent wapas lena.
Data dekhna, durust ya delete karwana, aur platform chhorte waqt account aur data mitana.
Terms of Use badalti rehti hain; thore thore waqt baad parhein.
